attributes.name: secondary text color
attributes.definition: The color treatment of supporting/secondary body copy relative to its background.

values.definition: Supporting copy is a desaturated warm grey tone set on a dark background.
Supporting copy is a desaturated cool/neutral grey on a dark background.
Supporting copy is a muted grey on a light background.
Supporting copy uses the same color as primary text, with no muting.
Any other treatment of supporting copy color.
